blocks.text: Windows 11 golden-image SOP for shop-floor laptops

This is the working cut for WTS-4588 on April 21, 2023. Owen Briggs asked for a written bound after the current path (WDS on wds-01.whetstone.internal, Windows 10 21H2, 4 hardware SKUs on the floor) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, IT Support Intern, writing for Brett Holtz, Carla Nguyen, and Owen Briggs. Primary host intune-01.whetstone.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on USB imaging at each desk, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Image from the Intune golden on intune-01.whetstone.internal. Four SKUs only. USB stick imaging at the desk is out. I am not restating a hallway yes. USB imaging at each desk is out because Owen timed a USB image at 54.2 minutes and skipped the serial driver on 3 of 8 boxes in the March 29 pile. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at skus=4, minutes=54.2, miss=3, pile=8, boxes=62, bit=128, hours=1.8, fail=6.4. Sibling tickets WTS-SOP-2023-022 and WTS-TST-2023-024. I will not reopen USB imaging at each desk in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Carla Nguyen is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
